turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
"Get this over with." I'm writing that down. You can get it over with by withdrawing the zero, Hale, or by telling me what you have besides a piece of software.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My child never lies, and "everyone knows it" isn't evidence, it's gossip. Who is everyone, Hale? If that's all you have, I'm going to the principal's office when I walk out of this room.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.

Asking a teacher to follow the school's own procedure isn't bullying. Section 4.2 says you contact me before any mark goes in, and section 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero, yes or no?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You didn't answer, so I'll take that as a no. I'm writing that down too. Twenty minutes is what I came with, Hale, and you've spent five of them insulting my son.
